response: Neither obesity nor OSA severity has a significant influence on the response of autotitrating CPAP machines in very obese subjects. In this population, factors such as BMI, neck circumference, and waist circumference are not predictive of autoCPAP pressure. Additionally, the correlation between OSA severity and autoCPAP pressure is only moderate, suggesting that other factors may play a role in determining the appropriate CPAP pressure. Therefore, the previously derived algorithm may not adequately predict the fixed CPAP pressure for clinical use in these obese individuals.
